baseline_models.focus_anchor: The pairing of خَابَ with دَسَّىٰهَا makes the agent's concealment or covert insertion the operation that produces failure.
baseline_models.mechanism: The sought good is not merely lost from outside. The agent makes the pronoun's referent unavailable, so the capacity through which a good could be sought or realized is itself hidden from use.

activation_trace.role: The literal missed-object and deprived-fortune image supplies the result pole: effort reaches no benefit.
The literal covert insertion or concealment image supplies the operation that makes the referent inaccessible.

changed_reading.before: The ayah states that a person simply loses or is disappointed.
changed_reading.after: The failure is internally manufactured: the person disables access to the very self or capacity by which a sought good could be realized.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: خَابَ can picture a striking implement that will not kindle, while دَسَّىٰ can name spoiling or leading astray.
baseline_models.mechanism: Corruption changes the medium, not just the verdict. Repeated effort can continue, yet nothing ignites because the inward material through which intention should become action has been spoiled.

activation_trace.role: The literal fire-stick that gives no spark turns failure into an inability to convert striking effort into ignition.
The literal straying and spoiling image supplies the damage that explains why the inner medium no longer kindles.

changed_reading.before: Failure is only a negative judgment after an act.
changed_reading.after: Failure is a damaged conversion process: effort strikes, but a corrupted inner medium yields no living spark.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The deprivation field of خَابَ and the concealment field of دَسَّىٰهَا permit a material reading of inward depletion.
baseline_models.mechanism: What is hidden or corrupted is cut off from replenishment. The result is not only guilt but poverty of capacity: an interior that has lost its store, hunger that cannot be answered, or land that receives no rain.

activation_trace.role: The literal poverty, loss, hunger, and rainless-land cluster supplies a depleted material state for failure.
The literal hiding image functions as withdrawal from the channels by which the interior could be exposed and replenished.

changed_reading.before: The one who hides it receives an abstract moral loss.
changed_reading.after: Hiding it produces an impoverished, hungry, rainless interior whose powers can no longer be renewed.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The vanity or falsehood branch of خَابَ can combine with the hiddenness of دَسَّىٰهَا.
baseline_models.mechanism: When the actual referent is pushed out of sight, a surface remains that can pass for reality. Failure then consists in living through an appearance that cannot deliver what its presentation promises.

activation_trace.role: The literal vanity or falsehood image supplies an empty substitute that cannot fulfill its claim.
The literal concealment image places the real referent beneath the substitute surface.

changed_reading.before: The corruption is hidden but remains a private defect.
changed_reading.after: The hidden reality permits a false exterior to take its place, so failure includes misrepresentation and self-misrecognition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context gives both emergence into light and legitimate nocturnal covering. This prevents a flat equation of all hiddenness with corruption: دَسَّىٰهَا becomes terminal or mistimed concealment, a cover that refuses the return to disclosure and therefore arrests the cycle by which hidden potential becomes visible.

activation_trace.role: The literal hiding operation remains the focus anchor whose duration and function are revised by the surrounding cycle.
The literal emergence into the sun and appearance supplies the expected outward phase that terminal concealment blocks.
The literal unveiling and becoming manifest makes disclosure an active operation rather than mere ambient light.
The literal darkness of night supplies a legitimate bounded interval of hiddenness.
The literal cover laid over a thing shows that covering can serve a rhythm, sharpening the focus act as cover made one-way.

structural_cues: The repeated feminine -hā object moves through exposure, unveiling, and covering before returning in دَسَّىٰهَا.
Day and night alternate; the focus verb supplies no corresponding re-emergence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies appearance, unveiling, night, and covering; I infer that their alternation sets a functional norm and that the focus act fails by making concealment terminal. A live alternative is that دَسَّىٰهَا names direct corruption without any temporal claim.

changed_reading.before: Concealment itself is intrinsically the failure.
changed_reading.after: Cover can be legitimate and temporary; failure lies in turning it into a closed state that prevents renewed disclosure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earth, its spreading, the furrow-maker, and growth transform burial into an agronomic test. Hiding is not automatically sterile—a seed also enters the ground—but دَسَّىٰهَا is the handling that corrupts, compacts, or withholds conditions of emergence, while the adjacent alternative opens a furrow and tends increase.

activation_trace.role: The literal rainless land and deprivation image supplies the sterile endpoint of failed cultivation.
The literal spoiling operation distinguishes corrupt burial from generative placement in soil.
The literal soft fertile earth supplies a medium in which hiddenness can normally become growth.
The literal spreading and extension supplies open room for development, the spatial opposite of suppressive compaction.
The literal plougher who cuts earth makes success an active technique of opening a growth channel.
The literal increase and growth image supplies the observable output that differentiates cultivation from burial.

structural_cues: 91:9 and 91:10 mirror قَدْ plus an outcome verb plus مَن plus a causative verb with -hā.
The success verb immediately before the focus ayah also carries an earth-cutting branch.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fertile earth, spatial spreading, a plougher, growth, corrupting concealment, and rainless deprivation; I map the self to soil or seed and construe دَسَّىٰهَا as anti-cultivation. The live alternative is a non-material contrast of purification and corruption.

changed_reading.before: Putting the referent under cover is itself the condemned act.
changed_reading.after: The decisive question is whether hidden potential can emerge and increase: failure is a corrupt burial that makes the inner ground sterile.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context identifies the recurring feminine referent with the self as a whole and brackets it between formation and later leveling or omission. دَسَّىٰهَا can therefore be read as self-erasure: hiding or corrupting the whole formed self until its distinctions are flattened, an inward small-scale analogue of the terminal leveling later applied collectively.

activation_trace.role: The literal concealment image supplies the inward act by which the formed self is made absent.
The literal identity or very self of a thing makes the buried object a whole rather than one detachable appetite.
The literal straightness and completion in the entity supplies the formed integrity that concealment deforms.
The literal dropping or omission image activates a terminal flattening pole against the earlier completed form.

structural_cues: The same root س و ي and feminine object occur before and after the focus pair, at 91:7 and 91:14.
The -hā chain allows the inward focus act and the later collective endpoint to echo without forcing identical referents.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies selfhood, completed form, and a later omission branch; I infer semantic bracketing and an inward-to-collective scale relation. A live alternative is that the two س و ي occurrences carry separate constructive and destructive senses without making the focus act their bridge.

changed_reading.before: A person hides one morally bad feature of an otherwise intact self.
changed_reading.after: The person makes the whole formed self unavailable and flattened, rehearsing inwardly a loss of distinction that can later appear at collective scale.

context_deltas.mechanism: The insertion side of د س و becomes active beside a breached covering and a protective barrier. The focus can describe not only pushing the self out of sight but also placing corruptive material secretly into it through a failed boundary.

activation_trace.role: The literal hidden insertion image supplies covert inward entry as an alternative direction for the focus operation.
The literal spoiling image identifies the functional effect of what is covertly inserted.
The literal deviation and breach of a covering supplies the compromised boundary through which hidden corruption can enter.
The literal warding of harm supplies the protective function whose failure permits covert ingress.

structural_cues: 91:8 places rupture and protection as paired possibilities before the two opposed outcomes in 91:9-10.
The object suffix on دَسَّىٰهَا favors hiding the self, but the root inventory independently preserves insertion as a live directional possibility.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hidden insertion, spoiling, a breached cover, and protection; I supply the arrow in which a breached boundary permits corruptive ingress. The materially live alternative is the more direct outward reading: the agent hides the self rather than inserts anything into it.

changed_reading.before: The agent covers or buries the self from the outside.
changed_reading.after: The agent may also corrupt the self by admitting or planting something covertly inside it through a breached protective boundary.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later denial activates a garment-like false exterior. Concealment does not leave a neutral blank; it enables a presentation that lies about the condition beneath it, turning inward suppression into public misrepresentation.

activation_trace.role: The literal vanity or falsehood image supplies the empty claim whose promised result fails.
The literal concealment image places the actual inner condition beneath an exterior.
The literal garment that misreports its wearer's condition gives the concealed self a deceptive social surface.

structural_cues: The narrative resumes immediately after the focus verdict with collective denial.
A singular inward operation is followed by a plural public act, permitting a scale shift from self-concealment to shared appearance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies vanity, concealment, and a garment whose appearance is false; I infer that the false exterior forms over the hidden self. A live alternative is that denial merely follows corruption without functioning as its covering surface.

changed_reading.before: The buried condition is private and socially invisible.
changed_reading.after: Burial generates a false public surface, so the failure includes maintaining an appearance that conceals and misstates the self beneath it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Inward suppression and outward excess become opposite phases of one latent system. What a group keeps hidden can accumulate like overpassing water, be stirred from rest, and emerge through a single maximally wretched agent; the focus subject can thus be carried at both personal and collective scales.

activation_trace.role: The literal corruption image supplies the latent disposition stored within the person or group.
The literal water rising beyond its limit supplies outward overflow as the release phase of suppressed corruption.
The literal stirring of something stationary supplies the transition from latent condition to activated conduct.
The literal wretchedness branch supplies the human proxy in whom the group's buried condition becomes concentrated and visible.

structural_cues: The sequence after the focus moves from collective transgression to the arousal of one superlative individual.
The focus uses indefinite مَن, which can remain personal while also serving as a pattern instantiated within a group.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concealment or corruption, floodlike excess, arousal from rest, and a wretched agent; I infer a compression-to-release chain and collective externalization through a proxy. A live alternative is that these are parallel moral facts and the later actor is independently responsible rather than an outlet for the group.

changed_reading.before: One isolated person privately corrupts one isolated self.
changed_reading.after: A group may bury a shared disposition until it overflows through an activated representative, while personal agency remains live within the collective mechanism.

context_deltas.mechanism: Speech, message, and an allotted channel of water make the buried content more specific: it can be an already recognized claim that is kept from governing conduct. Failure is then not simple ignorance but suppression of an inwardly apprehended and publicly articulated limit.

activation_trace.role: The literal concealment image supplies the suppression of a claim that has reached awareness.
The literal saying held within and not manifested supplies an internal acknowledgment that can be buried rather than enacted.
The literal messenger and message externalize the claim, removing lack of communication as the only explanation.
The literal share of watering and its channel gives the communicated limit a concrete resource-allocation function.

structural_cues: 91:13 combines an act of saying with a named living claimant and its watering claim.
The message follows the activation of an agent, so knowledge and action are narratively separated.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inward unspoken saying, an external message, and a watering allotment; I infer that دَسَّىٰهَا can suppress recognition of another's concrete claim. A live alternative is that these details only narrate a later episode and do not specify what was buried in the focus ayah.

changed_reading.before: The failure comes from a vague inner corruption or lack of moral awareness.
changed_reading.after: The failure can consist in burying a limit already known inwardly and stated publicly, especially when that limit governs another's share.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later sequence scales inner spoiling into destruction of generative infrastructure: the root is cut, the medium becomes barren, and extirpation follows, opposite a branch of nourishment and growth. دَسَّىٰهَا is therefore a small-scale beginning of root-destruction, not a condition that remains safely hidden.

activation_trace.role: The literal rainless deprivation image supplies sterility as the focus-level result.
The literal spoiling image supplies the inward first stage of the destructive progression.
The literal root or base of a thing turns the violent act into removal of generative support.
The literal barren sand that does not grow supplies the ecological output of root-cutting.
The literal extirpation image supplies the collective terminal scale of the process.
The non-dominant mapped branch's literal nourishment and growth image supplies the live counter-mechanism to barrenness and extirpation.

structural_cues: Repeated fa- in 91:14 accelerates denial, hamstringing, and extirpation into a causal-looking sequence.
The earlier growth contrast of 91:9-10 returns at a larger ecological and communal scale.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies spoiling, root or base, barrenness, extirpation, and a split-root nourishment image; I align them as a scale progression from inward damage to destroyed generativity. A live alternative is that the later actions are consequences in narrative sequence but do not unpack the inner mechanics of دَسَّىٰهَا.

changed_reading.before: Inner corruption can remain concealed and bounded within its possessor.
changed_reading.after: Inner spoiling tends toward cutting the roots of shared life, replacing nourishment and growth with barrenness and eventual extirpation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Tail, end, expected harm, aftermath, and remainder make failure longitudinal. Concealment can appear to erase a cause and may produce no immediate alarm, but what is hidden leaves a trailing effect by which the verdict خَابَ is eventually disclosed.

activation_trace.role: The literal missing of the sought result supplies failure as an outcome measured beyond the immediate act.
The literal concealment image supplies the apparent disappearance of the cause before its effects return.
The literal tail or end of a thing supplies a consequence that remains attached behind the concealed act.
The literal dread that anticipates harm supplies the subjective alarm whose absence need not cancel objective failure.
The literal end and aftermath of a thing supplies the later horizon on which failure becomes legible.
The literal remainder and trace supplies evidence that burial never fully removes what was done.

structural_cues: ذَنۢبِهِمْ in 91:14 and عُقْبَٰهَا in 91:15 close the sequence with tail, end, and consequence vocabulary.
The perfect خَابَ can state a verdict whose evidence unfolds after the concealing act.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a tail or end, anticipatory fear, aftermath, and residual trace; I infer that hidden causes return through delayed effects and that felt fear is not the measure of failure. A live alternative is that the aftermath language belongs only to the later destructive act, not to the focus subject's concealment.

changed_reading.before: Failure is an immediate disappointment that the agent should feel at once.
changed_reading.after: The agent may seem successful and feel no alarm in the short term; failure is disclosed by the tail, remainder, and aftermath that concealment cannot erase.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it is activated by a non-dominant split mapping of the sky root into narrow-aperture and poison imagery, not by the ordinary sky sense. It remains valid as a material analogy because the focus root itself supplies hidden insertion and corruption. Downstream prose should label it an exploratory ingress model, never a lexical claim that the sky wording means poison.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The insertion and spoiling possibilities inside دَسَّىٰهَا anchor a model of corruption entering covertly through a minute opening.

activation_trace.role: The literal hidden insertion image anchors the direction of covert entry.
The literal spoiling image anchors the harmful transformation caused after entry.
The non-dominant branch's literal narrow aperture supplies the small, easily missed route of ingress.
The non-dominant branch's literal poison entering a body supplies the cross-domain model of inward corruption.

changed_reading.before: Self-corruption is a large, visible choice to bury the whole self.
changed_reading.after: Corruption may begin as minute covert ingress through an unguarded aperture and spoil the self from within before concealment is noticed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the packet's ل ه م inventory activates swallowing rather than an ordinary cognitive gloss. It remains anchored through the focus root's covert insertion and corruption, producing a testable ingestion analogy: inward reception without transformation. Downstream prose should present this only as a branch-triggered model and must not imply that inspiration itself is corrupt.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: دَسَّىٰهَا can picture content placed secretly within and then spoiled, allowing the inward reception of 91:8 to be tested as digestion rather than mere possession.

activation_trace.role: The literal hidden insertion image anchors inward reception that remains unexposed and unworked.
The literal spoiling image supplies the risk when received material is not differentiated or transformed.
The literal swallowing and taking in completely supplies an ingestion model for inward reception.
The literal placing of oneself within protection supplies the selective boundary needed for safe inward reception.

changed_reading.before: Receiving an inner distinction is sufficient so long as it is present somewhere within.
changed_reading.after: What enters inwardly must be discriminated and integrated; swallowing it whole and leaving it hidden can turn reception into an undigested source of corruption.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it joins a non-dominant split branch of ت ل و with the follower or tail branch of ذ ن ب across a wide span. It remains anchored in the focus root's explicit spoiling of a person and explains how an inward pattern could become transmissible. Downstream prose should qualify it as a social propagation model, not a direct sense of any one focus word.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The corrupting sense of دَسَّىٰ permits the focus operation to become a pattern learned and repeated rather than an isolated hidden state.

activation_trace.role: The literal leading-astray and spoiling image anchors an operation that can be done to another and therefore copied socially.
The non-dominant branch's literal following in error supplies transmission by imitation along a sequence.
The literal followers or tails image supplies the social remainder that trails and reproduces an initiating corruption.

changed_reading.before: The buried corruption ends within the individual who performs it.
changed_reading.after: The corrupted pattern can acquire followers, propagate by imitation, and leave a social tail beyond the initiating self.

strongest_changes: The light-dark cycle revises concealment from an intrinsically bad state into cover made terminal: failure is refusal or prevention of re-emergence.
The earth, ploughing, and growth network turns the focus pair into rival cultivation techniques: a productive furrow opens growth, while corrupt burial leaves the inner ground rainless.
The self and repeated س و ي frame دَسَّىٰهَا as loss of whole formed integrity, with an inward flattening that can scale into collective destruction.
The final tail and aftermath vocabulary relocates the proof of failure from immediate feeling to delayed traces that concealment cannot erase.
summary.what_was_special: The packet sustained several non-equivalent readings at once: concealment as terminal cover, anti-cultivation, covert ingress, false exterior, latent collective pressure, self-flattening, and delayed consequence. Split-root branches added contained but productive aperture-poison, ingestion, nourishment, and propagated-following models without displacing the focus anchors.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the primary direction of دَسَّىٰهَا is outward concealment of the self, inward insertion into it, or an intentionally live overlap.
Whether temporary hiddenness can be positively gestational in this ayah, or whether only the surrounding cosmic cycle supplies that counterfactual.
How strongly the later communal narrative should be read as the causal unfolding of 91:10 rather than as an independent example.
Whether the two س و ي occurrences warrant a form-to-flattening bracket or should remain semantically separate.
The non-dominant split-root outliers are mechanistically useful but remain branch-distant and should never be promoted to direct lexical glosses.
